elements_selected.content: `zetl cap audit-diff <old-ref> <new-ref>` + test corpus per REQ-3424 + ADR-3410 (BUG-016 resolution). Scans vault diff for: external-origin links to previously-unseen domains, raw HTML surviving the sanitiser allowlist, dynamically-constructed URIs, markdown constructs that render to unusual HTML. Paired with `tools/audit-diff-corpus/` — versioned repo of known-malicious patterns + XSS cheatsheet samples + exfiltration templates. CI job `audit-corpus` runs audit-diff against corpus; fails on ANY miss. Corpus update cadence: monthly OR on any reported evasion.
